title: Edit code containing regex or escapes with the Edit tool, not generated JS strings
body:
Use the Edit tool for any replacement whose new text contains backslashes (regex classes like \s, \n literals, Windows paths). String-replacement scripts written in heredocs and template literals drop one level of escaping silently, and CRLF files make exact-match replacements fail.

Why: On 2026-09-22 heredoc-generated edits turned /\s+/ into /s+/ in src/engine/retrieve.js and broke two other regexes; the previous version of this memory carried a project-wide src/** scope, which injected it into every task in the benchmark, so this version has no file scope.

evidence.summary: headline() regexes that were corrupted and then fixed
benchmark where the src/** scope made this memory noise in every task
Anchored delivery: keywords validated against this memory's own text and a generic-request corpus before proposing.

v1.trigger: when about to change source through a node -e or heredoc script whose new text contains backslashes, regular expressions or newline literals
